requirements: R1: The system must securely generate a randomized fallback password (e.g., using SecureRandom) for new users authenticating via SSO, rather than deterministically deriving it from their username.

slices.title: Secure Fallback Password Generation
slices.jtbd: When implementing secure fallback passwords for this epic, I want the password to be randomly generated, so that the fallback account cannot be trivially compromised using the username.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a new user authenticating via SSO,
When their local fallback account is created,
Then their initial fallback password is securely randomized rather than deterministically derived from their username.
And appropriate tests verify the password is no longer derived from the username.

requirements: R1: The system must rigorously validate the 'iss' (Issuer) claim against the trusted Moodle provider and the 'aud' (Audience) claim against the application's client ID for all incoming OIDC ID tokens.

slices.title: OIDC Token Audience and Issuer Validation
slices.jtbd: When implementing OIDC token validation for this epic, I want to verify 'iss' and 'aud' claims, so that tokens from untrusted sources or for other clients are rejected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an incoming OIDC ID token,
When the system validates it,
Then it must verify that the 'iss' claim matches the trusted Moodle provider and the 'aud' claim matches the application's client ID.
And tokens failing these checks are rejected.
And automated tests verify that tokens with invalid 'iss' or 'aud' claims are denied access.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: rejected invalid tokens / authentication success rate
